slots.extractedText:
As hedge: prune to shape as specified.
As shrub: prune to 600 mm.

Prune to 450 mm to encourage dense,
basal branching.

After flowering prune back as necessary
to maintain a tight cushion form or tight
overhanging form if planted in balcony
planters.

Remove dead wood and withered leaves.
Thin out when overcrowded.
Moderate pruning to remove old wood.
